title: 凯特琳·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 深蓝长发衬着挺括高帽，精致剪裁的服装保留整洁优雅线条。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Caitlyn is an adult Piltover woman with long dark blue hair, clear blue eyes, a structured tall hat, and refined tailored clothing. Preserve the purple-blue and gold costume silhouette through a fully covering high-collared coat, opaque trousers or tights, gloves, and boots. Her distinctive precision rifle is held low with the muzzle directed at empty ground, finger away from the trigger and no aiming.
art_direction.scene: A low three-quarter full-figure study, grounded relaxed stance, clear triangular silhouette and one bright diagonal of sunlight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: ink blue, dusty violet, pale gold, warm limestone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
